name: game-authoring-review
goal: Preserve focused authoring edits and paid image results, scope traces by view, recover failed project creation, and generate correctly dimensioned game scaffolds.

evidence: Focused checkpoint and mechanics text is lost before blur; trace entries cross view boundaries; guidance edits drop a paid result; failed generation or Git blocks retry; generated 3D views and scaffold guidance incorrectly say 2D/apps.

Existing authoring tests blurred inputs before saving and did not reuse checkpoint ids across views. Image tests changed selection but not in-flight guidance. Creation tested only success/existing folders; generator tests did not assert dimensions or accurate info guidance. Extend those same standard matrices.
